headline: Severity restriction worked directionally exactly as R22 predicted (union lift 2.07 -> 3.74; controls barely attenuate 4.08 -> 3.43 = NOT size-disguise) and the pre-registered PRIMARY nominally PASSES (controlled OR 3.43, cluster-robust p=0.011 < 0.05). BUT the evidence reduces to ~6 late-filer company-episodes: the pre-registered ticker-bootstrap lift CI [0.95, 7.25] includes 1, leave-one-out shows any of 3 single firms kills significance, and cluster-robust inference is invalid at 6 event-clusters. => Prediction is coherent but NOT robustly established. No capital / filter claim. Frontier open: proper power needs the full DART filer universe (K200uKQ150 large-caps almost never file late).

prereg_primary_literal.rule: controlled OR(pred) > 1 AND cluster-robust p < 0.05 full-sample (on hardened target)
prereg_primary_literal.why_not_actionable: The nominal PASS rests on cluster-robust asymptotics that are invalid with only 6 event-carrying clusters; the pre-registered robustness test (d, ticker-bootstrap) does NOT clear 1, and leave-one-ticker-out shows 3/6 event-tickers are each individually decisive. Reporting this is a VALIDITY disclosure of the primary statistic, not a post-hoc goalpost move.

comparison_to_R22.interpretation: Removing transient LongHalt concentrated the point estimate exactly as R22 D1 predicted. The severity restriction is directionally validated. The binding wall shifted from 'dilution' (R22) to 'too few independent late-filer episodes' (R23) - a power/universe wall, not a signal-absence wall.

fragility.monthly_overlap: 12-month hold => one late-filing episode spawns up to 12 monthly hits for the same firm => 47 monthly hits ~ 6 independent company-episodes
fragility.cluster_robust_validity: 6 clusters << the ~30-40 needed for cluster-robust SE reliability => nominal p=0.011 anti-conservative

placebo_month_permuted.note: rules out within-month artifact; does not rescue few-cluster problem

stability.pre2016: NOT ESTIMABLE (<5 worst-decile events; delay feature coverage post-2016-heavy)
stability.verdict: all signal post-2016 (alpha-decay regime); temporal robustness UNESTABLISHED not disproven

aux_delisting_hazard.interpretation: continuous days-late does NOT predict delisting -> signal is EXTREME-TAIL concentrated, non-monotonic (confirms R22 D2). Widening the threshold dilutes; power must come from more late-filer episodes (universe), not a smoother predictor.

per_type_worst_decile_lift.note: identical to R22 D1 -> pipeline internal consistency confirmed

label_pit_hardening.source: stage_artifacts/WT-D20260710_005/disc_ck (506,874 rows, 348 stocks, actual 관리종목지정 / 불성실공시법인지정 disclosure dates)
label_pit_hardening.coverage: 36 of 2492 AdminStock/UnfaithfulDisc onsets matchable (disc_ck survivor-biased to 348 current stocks; delisted names absent)
label_pit_hardening.conclusion: NO systematic backdating: flag onset == public designation month in 89% of matchable cases (median gap 0). RAWDATA flag onset is PIT-clean as a designation-date proxy. Hardened target == pure-flag target (identical base rate & event count) -> hardening confirms cleanliness but does not move the verdict.
label_pit_hardening.honest_coverage_caveat: Only the covered subset is directly verifiable; the full-target backdating cleanliness is inferred from the 36-event matched sample, which is small. Direction of any residual backdating = would inflate predictability, so the null-actionable verdict is conservative.

two_stage_discipline: Stage-2 (exclusion filter redesign) NOT opened. A fragile, non-robust prediction does not license any de-mining filter or capital claim.

next_probe.P1: POWER VIA UNIVERSE (primary): re-run identical severity-restricted worst-decile delay test on the FULL DART filer universe (all KOSPI+KOSDAQ filers, not just K200uKQ150). Rationale: large-caps almost never file late (only ~6 extreme late-filers in 15y here); the mechanism is real but the deployment universe starves it of independent episodes. Full-universe should yield dozens-hundreds of independent late-filer->severe-outcome episodes -> proper cluster count for valid inference. NEW pre-registered round.
next_probe.P2: EPISODE-LEVEL DESIGN: collapse the 12-month monthly-overlap to one observation per (ticker, late-filing episode) with a discrete-time survival/hazard model, so the effective n equals independent episodes (not autocorrelated monthly hits). Report firm-clustered wild bootstrap. Removes the '47 hits = 6 firms' inflation at the design level.
next_probe.P3: LABEL-HARDENING COVERAGE EXPANSION: extend the disc_ck disclosure archive to the delisted / managed micro-cap tail (currently survivor-biased 348 stocks) to verify designation-date PIT-cleanliness on the event-carrying names themselves (currently only 36/2492 verifiable).

disposition: delay(F3) severity-restricted = CONFIG_SCOPED_NEGATIVE (prediction not robustly established) + FRONTIER_OPEN. Feature preserved (m1/Benford already terminated in R22). The severity-restriction hypothesis is directionally CONFIRMED; the binding wall is now universe-power (too few late-filer episodes in large-caps), which is addressable (P1).
